items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Norman went to each of the people and said, I'm making this record, this album and I want to give each of you people a side on the twelve inch record, carte blanche.

ctx.x: Norman went to each of the people and said, I'm making this record, this album and I want to give each of you people a side on the twelve inch record, carte blanche. If you went fifty men, fifty violins, a symphony, you've got it. If you want to go in the studio alone and just sit at the piano, you've got it.
If you want to do it with a string quartet, anything, carte blanche, anything.
